about: One source for STEM's guards and their wiring per agent. scripts/hooks-sync.py writes the agent config files and docs/agent/HOOKS.md from this file; edit here, never there. Order per guard: native hook, else an agent-independent mechanism (git hook, scripts/run.sh), else the instruction sentence.

codex.name: Codex
codex.evidence: automated probe runs; hooks need the user's trust (bound to the file's hash); PreToolUse wiring observed in one CLI run (codex-cli 0.166.0, 2026-11-11: the large-read note reached the model, the deny guard stopped the command); the Codex app and the trust review itself are not covered

deutschlandgpt.name: DeutschlandGPT Code
deutschlandgpt.evidence: from its documentation only, no run recorded; the app documents no hooks

guards.purpose: State summary at the start of a session
guards.fallback: instruction: the agent runs the script itself (AGENTS.md, Session start)

guards.purpose: Notice when the context is large and a new session is due
guards.fallback: scripts/run.sh prints the notice after a run when the session log is found; else instruction: core rule 9

guards.purpose: Warning before a whole-file read of a large file
guards.fallback: instruction: read files over 8 KB in parts; command output goes through scripts/run.sh

guards.purpose: No destructive git command, no skipped git hooks, no read of .env files or SSH keys
guards.fallback: Claude Code: deny rules in .claude/settings.json (same list); elsewhere pre-push hook and core rules 6 and 8

guards.purpose: Reminder to detach a session started for a handoff (Claude desktop app only)
guards.fallback: not applicable outside the Claude desktop app

guards.purpose: No secrets, source documents or half-finished Done tasks in a commit
guards.fallback: git hook, the same for every agent (core.hooksPath, set at setup)

guards.purpose: No force push, no deletion of a remote branch
guards.fallback: git hook, the same for every agent; other destructive git commands: deny rules where the agent has them, else core rule 6

guards.purpose: Commit messages carry a task ID
guards.fallback: git hook, the same for every agent
